title: Wonderful
text: Rodri was very experienced with his photography. Friendly, helpful and social. We had a great experience working with him.
author: X9373ILivane

title: Must book!! You won’t regret!!
text: Borja was awesome! Super accommodating! Took the best photos of us in 15 min than we took in 10 days! He captured the authentic laughs and connections of our family as we’re exploring and taking in the beauty of Barcelona! This is a must! You won’t be disappointed!! Well worth it!
author: Reyna_N

title: We had a blast! Amazing pictures
text: My bf and me had a photoshoot with a local photographer from Smiler and it was amazing. She showed us all the cute spots in the gothic quarter and we had a blast. Such an amazing memory while traveling through Europe!
author: annarY294BK
